text.content:
Roll on this table (or reuse an entry) whenever a random encounter check triggers on this floor. Every entry assumes goblins traveling with, arguing about, or actively herding a llama - keep that at the front of any improvisation.

  • A patrol passes through on its rotation, a goblin or two herding a visibly unenthusiastic llama; a failed Perception check meets it head-on. (near Chamber, Room 5)
  • The room refills with a new threat if left and returned to later, on this same table. (near Corridor Junction, Room 12)
  • Something has noticed the party lingering - roll a check when they stay more than a few minutes. (near Chamber, Room 10)
  • A lone goblin scout mistakes the party for potential recruits and earnestly tries to explain the nuzzle-hierarchy promotion system before anyone can stop it. Not dangerous unless the party makes it so - but it will absolutely alert nearby patrols if the conversation runs long.
  • A stray llama - unaffiliated, uninterested in the warren's politics - wanders through at the worst possible moment, dragging a snapped tether and several confused, shouting goblins behind it.
